selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is the name of the Third Truth in the target passage?
questions.answer: It is the truth about Allah’s managing and running things.

questions.question: Which two opposite kinds of created things are mentioned to show the wide reach of this control?
questions.answer: Very great heavenly bodies and very weak earthly creatures are mentioned.

questions.question: What three large pictures are used for the world in the passage?
questions.answer: A perfect kingdom, a splendid city, and a decorated palace.

questions.question: How are all these different created things connected in the passage?
questions.answer: They are made to assist one another and are governed together.

questions.question: Why is the spring season a strong proof in this passage?
questions.answer: Because in spring many kinds of life appear together in careful order.

questions.question: What three comparisons describe the world under this administration?
questions.answer: It is like a flawless kingdom, a great city, and a richly prepared palace.

questions.question: What would happen if an ordinary cause tried to interfere with that huge administration?
questions.answer: Order would be ruined and confusion would begin.

questions.question: What happens to the species in autumn?
questions.answer: Many of them are dismissed from their tasks and depart through death.

questions.question: Why is death described as a kind of leave from duty in the passage?
questions.answer: It presents living things as creatures serving for a time and then being released.

questions.question: What is the main subject of the target passage?
questions.answer: It is about Allah’s perfect control and arrangement of creation.

questions.question: What does “administering” mean in this passage?
questions.answer: It means managing, arranging, and taking care of everything properly.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the creatures living on earth?
questions.answer: They are needy and weak.

questions.question: How is the whole world pictured when this rule is described?
questions.answer: It is pictured as an excellently run realm and a beautifully ordered place.

questions.question: What does the passage say happens between these different parts of creation?
questions.answer: They are made to support each other.

questions.question: What does the commander provide for each group in the comparison?
questions.answer: He gives each group its own clothing, weapons, instructions, release, and pay.

questions.question: How is autumn described in relation to the day of resurrection?
questions.answer: It is described as an example or reminder of it.

questions.question: What season removes many of these species from duty?
questions.answer: Autumn does.

questions.question: How is autumn linked to resurrection in the passage?
questions.answer: It serves as a small likeness of the day when creatures are brought back and gathered.

questions.question: What title is given to the Third Truth?
questions.answer: It is called the truth of disposing and administering.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the movement and condition of the heavenly bodies?
questions.answer: They are huge and move swiftly.

questions.question: What does the passage say is done for all these things besides simply creating them?
questions.answer: Their needs are handled and their affairs are arranged.

questions.question: Which vulnerable beings are mentioned along with them?
questions.answer: The weak and needy dwellers of the earth are mentioned.

questions.question: In the comparison, how many different groups are in the army?
questions.answer: There are four hundred thousand different groups.

questions.question: What does the passage say we can see with our own eyes every spring?
questions.answer: We can see an unseen hand creating and directing a huge army of living species.
